cohort: 9223 primiparous women with singleton, appropriately grown babies born at term
finding: Term, appropriately grown male babies in primiparous pregnancies were more likely to experience adverse intrapartum and neonatal outcomes compared to female babies, even after adjusting for birthweight.
mod_finding: Male babies were more likely to be delivered by instrumental delivery (OR 1.24, p<0.001), as well as by emergency caesarean for failure to progress (OR 1.24, p=0.04) and fetal distress (OR 1.38, p<0.001).
